claims.summary: For A_s=(Z/2^s)[zeta]/(zeta²+zeta+1), any rectangular matrix R over A_(v+1) with entries divisible by2^v is equivalent by invertible row/column operations to diag(2^v I_r,0), where r is the F4 rank of def_v(R). Lift residue-field Gaussian operations; higher errors vanish after multiplication by2^v. A chosen H-column domain minor nonzero mod2 is a unit in every lift and gives a split free A_s^H submodule, without asserting freeness of the full weight image or increasing polynomial degree.

claims.rationale: Identifies the precise information retained by minimal-precision aggregation and removes an unnecessary extra primitivity assumption on a chosen common-domain basis.
claims.next_action: Seek source-specific unit-rank information rather than computing an equivalent top-layer normal form.
